source.quote: We now expect to be able to improve our full year consolidated operating margin by 2.5 percentage points to 3 percentage points, driven by increased scale, a friendly ATM pricing environment and SPIL synergies.
We expect to have an effective tax rate for the year of between 20% to 21% during the full year.
HoldCo 2021 operating margin target should exceed or at the higher end target 2.5% to 3%, as we previously guided.
However, for the full year, we believe that we will be unable to reach our EMS operating margin target of 4%.
On a U.S. dollar basis, our ATM revenues grew by 15% sequentially, which is slightly ahead of our own expectations.
Altogether, we expect ATM 2025 full year revenue to exceed our target and grow over 20% year-over-year in U.S. dollar terms.
We continue to expect an effective tax rate of 18% for the year.

Based on our current business outlook and exchange rate assumption of $1 to TWD 31.9 versus last quarter's TWD 31.6, management projects overall performance for the third quarter of 2026 to be as follows: -- on a consolidated basis, in NT dollar terms, our consolidated third quarter revenue should grow by 21% to 22% quarter-over-quarter.
Our consolidated third quarter gross margin should be between 12.5% to 21.5%.
Our consolidated third quarter operating margin should be between 11.5% to 12.5%.
We continue to expect sequential margin improvement with fourth quarter ATM gross margin likely to exceed our structural margin ceiling of 30%.
Lastly, on ATM profitability, with expanding margin-accretive LEAP and test businesses, our second quarter ATM gross margin of 27.3% came in ahead of our guidance.
Given these changes, we now expect our full year effective tax rate to be between 16% to 17%.
Our consolidated fourth quarter gross margin should be between 23% to 24%.
Our consolidated fourth quarter operating margin should be between 14.5% to 15.5%.
And for next year, we are expecting over $1 billion revenue coming from full process.
